{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f9ff9390-ec33-4196-9703-9ad64c0caacb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Using SciPy distributions\n",
    "\n",
    "Use a frozen SciPy distribution in a reliability model and check its parameters before running FORM and SORM.\n",
    "\n",
    "**Before you start:** the introductory tutorial."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "cbadfd4c-6427-406f-829a-68d9e036bf47",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-13T07:32:36.722551Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-13T07:32:36.722361Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-13T07:32:37.891181Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-13T07:32:37.890315Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import pystra as ra\n",
    "from scipy.stats import genextreme as gev\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "becaa3e2-146f-43a5-9ef7-9d92ae1c4368",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Define the limit state function"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "9bac7534-25fb-4d5d-9579-fc112f58b2fc",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-13T07:32:37.893315Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-13T07:32:37.893052Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-13T07:32:37.896226Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-13T07:32:37.895379Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def lsf(X1, X2, C):\n",
    "    return X1 - X2 - C\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "cbb6c7e2-eeac-46c4-b8fb-fb0154e6da97",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Create the GEV variable and plot that it is defined as intended:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "03ed32ce-2119-4e48-84a8-ba975955ee02",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-13T07:32:37.897718Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-13T07:32:37.897556Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.008099Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.007193Z"
    },
    "pystra": {
     "figure_alts": [
      "The SciPy GEV probability density shows the distribution produced by its shape, location and scale parameters; these parameters are not its physical mean and standard deviation."
     ]
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<Axes: >"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 3,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "X2 = ra.ScipyDist(\"X2\", gev(c=0.1, loc=200, scale=50))\n",
    "X2.plot()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1fbe0141",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**Figure.** The SciPy GEV probability density shows the distribution produced by its shape, location and scale parameters; these parameters are not its physical mean and standard deviation."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a466dbeb-494b-40a4-9312-a416608c3541",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now create the limit state and stochastic model objects, and add the variables"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "050c86ad-0bac-44aa-8ac7-c57f44af08c3",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.009833Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.009621Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.013444Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.012383Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "limit_state = ra.LimitState(lsf)\n",
    "\n",
    "model = ra.StochasticModel()\n",
    "model.add_variable(ra.Normal(\"X1\", 500, 100))\n",
    "model.add_variable(X2)\n",
    "model.add_variable(ra.Constant(\"C\", 50))\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "48834821-8daf-4378-824f-f46172e398ad",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Suppress the console output"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "e2d1ade5-3537-4ea2-b4be-48ce1a0501e9",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.015035Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.014852Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.017613Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.016820Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "options = ra.FORMOptions()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ea5ba1e0-3422-4b2e-9662-586495585bcd",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Execute a FORM analysis"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "caa2278c-906a-4897-8159-e96d460bc055",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.019156Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.018992Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.035669Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.034795Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "FORM result\n",
      "  Status                   converged\n",
      "  Message                  Converged\n",
      "  Failure probability      0.0249392\n",
      "  Reliability index        1.961\n",
      "  Iterations               5\n",
      "  Limit-state evaluations  39\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "form = ra.FORM(\n",
    "    model=model,\n",
    "    limit_state=limit_state,\n",
    "    options=options,\n",
    ")\n",
    "form_result = form.run()\n",
    "print(form_result.summary())\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "bfdafe33-8c71-4ffa-9523-1bab1d124471",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "And then a SORM analysis (passing the existing FORM object for efficiency)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "690f3795-6800-4045-b0ed-446d7558b01e",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.037328Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.037156Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.047177Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-13T07:32:38.046204Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "SORM result\n",
      "  Status                   converged\n",
      "  Message                  Fitted\n",
      "  Failure probability      0.0270706\n",
      "  Reliability index        1.9257\n",
      "  Fit                      curve\n",
      "  FORM reliability index   1.961\n",
      "  Pf, breitung             0.0270706\n",
      "  Pf, modified breitung    0.0275476\n",
      "  Limit-state evaluations  9\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "sorm = ra.SORM(model=model, limit_state=limit_state, form=form)\n",
    "sorm_result = sorm.run()\n",
    "print(sorm_result.summary())\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c4dbe893",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Interpretation\n",
    "\n",
    "A SciPy shape, location and scale describe that distribution’s own parameterisation; they are not generally its mean and standard deviation. Inspect the distribution before interpreting the reliability result."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f086bd13",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "**Continue:** [User guide](../guides/models.rst) · [API reference](../api/probability.rst) · [Theory](../theory/transformations.rst)"
   ]
  }
 ],
